changes.summary: Enable/disable the optional Instigator and set cooldown and per-task nudge budget. Disabled is the default.
Propose NUDGE or SILENT for an existing task revision and scope. Never changes task state, creates tasks or waits for approval.
Deliver due pending nudges; stale revision, expired, finished-task and disabled cases are discarded without waking the task.
Inspect the Instigator policy and recent message audit.

invariants.event: instigator.nudge only on delivery of a still-valid message
